verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that bizfile Online uses entity-linked "User Access" accounts, which become required for online Statement of Information filings from August 1, 2026. It never describes how a user signs in or verifies identity. There is nothing on whether login uses remotely completable credential MFA rather than biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN. Account gating alone is an adjacent control, not evidence of the sign-in mechanism, and the portal itself could not be probed beyond its bot-management shell.
